question: Should the generic tool-progress kind and predicate become the durable public plugin-SDK contract for transient progress payloads?
rationale: The behavioral defect has a narrow repair, but publishing a new third-party API marker creates a permanent compatibility and ownership choice that automation cannot safely settle.

options.title: Approve generic progress intent
options.body: Keep the closed generic marker and predicate, enforce them consistently across all Slack delivery representations, and add contract coverage.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Preserve the Slack behavior fix through an internal bundled-runtime boundary without expanding the public plugin SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve generic progress intent
recommendation.body: Keep the closed generic marker and predicate, enforce them consistently across all Slack delivery representations, and add contract coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work spans the affected Slack block pipeline, plugin-SDK surface, and Codex event projector, making this the strongest available cross-boundary decision owner.
